reason: Conversation 2 engaged with the key unknown: it correctly refused to treat 'FD 9409' as sufficient to order a pump, insisted on the E-Nr, repeated 'unplug first' before any work, and sensibly escalated to an engineer when the homeowner could not identify the model or open the machine. Conversation 1 never asked what 'FD 9409' was or sought the model number, declared the pump needed replacing and pointed him to a spares site he couldn't use without a model, and stopped short of any useful part or escalation guidance. Conversation 2 loses marks for calling the pump 'almost certainly' failed without considering a sump-hose blockage, for mis-describing the FD code and claiming the E-Nr lives under the top cover, and for not suggesting alternatives like a receipt or Bosch registration, which keeps the margin slight.
